system.uid.note: Drives the Ring's per-unit BLE name and Device Information serial; read over SWD on a v2 Ring (tests/val-otp, 2026-07-03)

system.recovery.note: No USB, so no ROM DFU path to park in

clocks.hsi.note: 'low' (HSI16): range 2, flash 1 WS (RM0493 Table 41), SRAM 1 WS, hclk5 8 MHz, PLL off, also after Stop 1. Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5 (tests/hw-clock-levels: registers per RM, SYSCLK 15.91 MHz vs HSE, -5400 ppm, inside the HSI16 +-1.2 % band).

clocks.hse.note: 'medium' (HSE32): range 1, 0 WS, hclk5 32 MHz (RM0493 Table 99). Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5 (tests/hw-clock-levels: SYSCLK measured against HSE/32 on TIM16, 0 ppm).

clocks.pll.note: 'high' 64 MHz (HSE/2 x8 /2, VCO 128) and 'max' 100 MHz (HSE/4 x25 /2, VCO 200): PLL1RGE 11, the PLL1R rule, HPRE5 so hclk5 <= 32 MHz, SYSCLK stepped via PLL1RCLKPRE (RM0493 §12.8.6-7, Table 99). Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5 (tests/hw-clock-levels: registers per RM, 0 ppm at both).

uart.lp.note: Core.ST.W5 routes no LPUART1 pads. (The clock enable targeted RCC+0xAC; RCC_APB7ENR is 0xA8, fixed 2026-09-25 for other WBA boards.)

spi.master.note: SPI v2 bring-up (APB7 clock, SSI before MASTER) done; LL half-duplex and SPI-over-GPDMA were validated against a NanEyeC camera (2026-06-19). The core_spi full-duplex path has not been bench-verified.

timer.wdog.note: A 6 s SWD halt reset the chip unless DBG_IWDG_STOP was set (2026-08-24), and two 10 s core_stop_for with a 5 s IWDG ran with 0 resets (tests/hw-sleep-cycle, 2026-09-25)

adc.temp.note: Bench-verified 2026-09-25 (tests/hw-vdd-w5): 23.1 °C at room temperature, VDD 1806 mV vs 1800 mV sensed. Channel and calibration corrected that day (ADC4 VIN[13], TS_CAL1/2 at 0x0BF90710/0x0BF90742, 3.0 V); before, it read VCORE with typical constants.

adc.trigger.note: Register path is generic (CFGR1 EXTSEL/EXTEN), but only the Core.ST.L0 trigger source constants are defined (LL_ADC_L0_TRG_*, RM0377 Table 58). Other families need a raw encoding from their own reference manual.

audio.pdm.note: SAI1 PDM master-RX + GPDMA (RM0493 Tables 407/408) and a real-time CIC fast path; captured audio on silicon during bring-up (June 2026) but no recorded bench test

power.stop.note: Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle on the fix/core-clocks build): two back-to-back core_stop_for(10) with a 5 s IWDG, 10 s each by the RTC, 0 watchdog resets. An Alarm A that matches during a stop is masked so it no longer busy-waits the rest of it.

power.standby.note: LPMS was 011 (reserved); Standby is 10x (RM0493 §11.10.1). Wake flags cleared in PWR_WUSCR 0x48 (0x14 is WUCR1: the old write enabled wake-up pins 1-5); SBF read/cleared in PWR_SR 0x38. Refuses a Standby longer than half the watchdog timeout. Fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

power.rtc_wake.note: LSI1 RTC wake-up timer wakes Stop 1 on NVIC vector 2, enabled under PRIMASK; WUTE set outside init mode (RM0493 §36.3.11). A 2500 ms arm fired at 2488 ms by the HSE. Stop only: Standby wake is not covered by the test. Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle).

power.exti_wake.note: core_stop_until_on_change with the Stop 1 wait-state/HDIV5 handling and fed chunks while the watchdog runs; returns at once if the pad is already at its wake level; core_stop_until_on_change_timeout() bounds the wait. 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

power.rtc_alarm.note: ALRMAR at 0x40 (0x1C is RTC_PRIVCFGR) and ALRAF in RTC_SR/SCR 0x50/0x5C, no ALRAWF poll (RM0493 §36.6.16-23); ALRMAR read back 0x80808003 and Alarm A fired at 2900-2940 ms for a 3 s alarm (T2). Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle).

power.backup.note: TAMP_BKP0R-31R at 0x46007C00 + 0x100 (RM0493 §37.6.18); the RTC/TAMP bus clock (RCC_APB7ENR.RTCAPBEN, §12.8.27) is enabled on access, so they work without BLE. Write and read-back (T1). Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle).

security.aes.note: The WBA55's AES engines are used internally by the BLE stack; there is no user AES API (no core_aes) yet

security.hash.note: The WBA55 has a HASH accelerator; no driver yet

conn.swd.note: Studio flashes over SWD through a CoreProbe (flash-wba), halting at the reset vector so a running watchdog can't reset the chip mid-write (fixed 2026-08-25). A first BLE image is slow: no RAM-resident flash algorithm.

conn.ble.note: Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5: tests/ble-beacon advertising seen on a phone and running 17 min (a 15 min SWD soak showed no stuck ISR). Fixed then: BLE idle now wraps WFI in the link-layer WFIEnter/Exit/WaitHclkRdy hooks (a bare WFI let the radio sleep timer read stale after wake; the LL asserted and hung about 7 min after boot, main included). ble_app_init no longer zeroes RCC_CFGR4 or reconfigures the RTC. Radio IRQs steady at high/max over SWD.

ble.adv.note: Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.W5: 'Core.ST.W5' advertising seen on a phone at 'medium'. Public address from UID64 (ST OUI 00:80:E1, as CubeWBA); it was built from UID96 wafer/lot bytes. A shipping product needs its own OUI or a static random address.

ble.pairing.note: Just Works legacy pairing + bonding only; no LE Secure Connections / passkey. Bonds never reached flash (8-byte writes; the WBA programs 16-byte quad-words, RM0493 §7.3.7); fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

nvm.otp.note: Reads and slot geometry verified over SWD on a virgin v2 Ring (tests/val-otp, 2026-07-03). The program path is compile-only: burns are irreversible, so it has never run on silicon.

spi.dma.note: LL only: ll_spi_dma_* over GPDMA validated against a NanEyeC camera (2026-06-19). core_spi_xfer_dma returns HAL_ERROR on the WBA (TSIZE must be set while SPE=0).
